newsitem.title: ROMANIA: BUCHAREST SHARE PRICES MIXED, TURNOVER SLIGHTLY UP.
newsitem.headline: BUCHAREST SHARE PRICES MIXED, TURNOVER SLIGHTLY UP.

text.p: Shares on the Bucharest stock exchange traded mixed on Monday in thin investor interest, which traders blamed on the summer holiday mood.
"There'll be little change in both the shorter and longer term and, frankly, I don't see any real action before early September," said a broker.

Sixteen average prices touched higher, 20 slipped and 11 marked time. Four stocks had no trade and one was suspended. Newcomer Promet metal parts maker also had no trade and plastics maker Prodplast, which joined in trading also on Monday, had only four trades involving 156 shares.
Three independent market indices, the VAB, the BIG and the CAS-SE, based on average prices and market capitalisation, fell by 0.9, 0.92 and 0.81 percent respectively from last Friday.
Overall volume rose to two million shares from 1.5 million and turnover was eight billion lei, some two billion up from the previous level.
The first tier took some 88 percent of total turnover and traders said stronger buying pressure in late trading pushed six of the nine high-caps to slightly higher closing quotes.
Oltchim took the bulk of volume and turnover in the top tier. It lost one percent on its average quote but managed to close flat at 3,800 lei.
